question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**adults**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage mentions that the study involved 25 young individuals with an **average age of 21.5 years**.
 
• People around this age are legally and socially considered **young adults**, not children or minors.
 
• Hence, the most suitable word for the blank is **adults**.
 
• Other options like **children** and **teenagers** do not fit, as their average age would be below 20, and **minors** implies those under 18, which contradicts the given average age of 21.5.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Children** – Refers to individuals below the age of 13; does not fit the context.
 
• **Teenagers** – Refers to people aged 13–19; the given average age (21.5) is beyond this range.
 
• **Minors** – Refers to anyone legally under 18; again inconsistent with the provided age.
